title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Schedule of Contingency Rates and Direct-Pay Terms
content:
Each tier of the Contingency Placement Agreements carries one contingency rate for every placement stage. The rate is the percent of the amount collected on an account of that stage that Ridgeline charges as its contingency fee.

## Contingency rate by placement stage (percent of the amount collected)

| Tier | Early-Out Placement | Primary Placement | Secondary Placement | Tertiary Placement | Warehouse Placement | Legal Review Placement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 15.0 | 30.0 | 38.0 | 45.0 | 50.0 | 40.0 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 14.0 | 28.0 | 35.0 | 42.0 | 48.0 | 38.0 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 12.5 | 25.0 | 32.0 | 40.0 | 45.0 | 35.0 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 11.0 | 22.5 | 30.0 | 37.5 | 42.5 | 33.0 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 10.0 | 20.0 | 27.5 | 35.0 | 40.0 | 30.0 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 8.5 | 18.0 | 25.0 | 32.5 | 38.0 | 28.0 |

## Direct-pay terms

A direct payment is a payment the consumer makes directly to the client rather than to Ridgeline.

- **Direct-pay fee share** — the share of the stage contingency rate charged on a direct payment, in percent of that rate.
- **Direct-pay free window** — the calendar days after the account's placement date within which a direct payment carries no fee.
- **Direct-pay reporting period** — the calendar days after receiving a direct payment within which the client must report it.

| Tier | Direct-pay fee share (percent of the stage rate) | Free window (calendar days after placement) | Reporting period (calendar days after receipt) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 100.0 | 0 | 10 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 100.0 | 0 | 10 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 100.0 | 5 | 10 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 75.0 | 10 | 15 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 50.0 | 10 | 15 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 50.0 | 15 | 15 |

## Reading the schedule

- A direct-pay fee share of 100.0 means the direct payment carries the full stage rate; a share of 50.0 means it carries half of the stage rate.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On the Select Volume Contingency Agreement, a Secondary Placement account carries 30.0 percent; a direct payment on that account, outside the free window, carries 75.0 percent of that rate, which is 22.5 percent of the payment.
